promptBrief: Gate 1 direction B, Cryo Deck desktop UI master
generationPrompt:
REAL DESKTOP APP UI MASTER, Direction B ? Cryo Deck. Create a pixel-perfect 1536x1024 screenshot of RambleDesk as an implementable cross-platform desktop productivity application. It uses the spatial metaphor of Vault Zero's quiet cryogenic deck, but must remain a practical document tool, never a game HUD, cockpit, poster, landing page, or framed mockup.

PRODUCT FLOW:
The user selects an Agent request, reviews test steps, starts or resumes a spoken Ramble, sees microphone level, captures screenshots, explicitly imports clipboard content or files, edits a rich Markdown feedback document with inline images, autosaves, submits, and can open the resulting Feedback Package.

LAYOUT:
Include a slim custom app titlebar inside the interface: hollow hexagonal RambleDesk emblem, current project, local connected state, settings, broad draggable region, Windows/Linux window controls, and adaptable safe space for macOS traffic lights.
Under the titlebar use three cabin-like vertical zones with subtle architectural depth:
1. Left task-pod rail around 250px: PENDING and HISTORY tabs, four capsule-like request pods, each with project, short task title, Agent, status light, and time.
2. Center archive-document bay is by far the largest region. Top has current request, a compact collapsible task brief with three numbered steps and context links. Main area is a Tiptap-like rich editor with restrained toolbar, paragraphs, quote, structured clipboard/context block, and an inline screenshot. The document remains visually dominant and comfortable.
3. Right live telemetry bay around 290px: START RAMBLE state button, microphone device and gentle level meter, explicit IMPORT CLIPBOARD, SCREENSHOT, and ADD FILE actions, autosave state, attachment chips, SUBMIT FEEDBACK, OPEN PACKAGE completed action.
Bottom can have a slim persistent save/submit rail.
Rambelle naturally emerges from the lower part of the right bay holding a translucent archive slate; keep her contained and never overlap the editor.

VISUAL SYSTEM:
Airy layered translucent panels that feel like cryogenic glass pods, but all layers must be reproducible with CSS. Pale metal #E3E9F0 and snow #F7F9FC dominate; ice blue #6FA8DC and technical cyan #57C6C0 mark selected and live states; amber #F2A03D only signals attention. Deep navy-gray type, thin cold-light edges, small cyan indicator dots, restrained shadows, 12?18px radii, rigorous alignment.
Subtly integrate the new hollow-center hexagonal vault-door pattern from the style reference. ONLY this new hexagonal emblem; never a circular zero or eye-like mark.
Rambelle matches the reference exactly: long pure white hair, ice-blue eyes, pale futuristic chief military secretary uniform, cel-shaded digital-pop style.
Text is sharp and concise: TASK PODS, ARCHIVE DOCUMENT, START RAMBLE, READY, IMPORT CLIPBOARD, SCREENSHOT, ADD FILE, SAVED, SUBMIT FEEDBACK, OPEN PACKAGE. Final implementation will localize to Simplified Chinese.
This is not a bitmap UI asset: live content, controls, and typography must remain separable implementable layers.

STRICTLY AVOID: dark-dominant cyberpunk, neon overload, sci-fi game HUD, vehicle cockpit, excessive glass blur, tiny pseudo-text, huge character art, old circular zero emblem, code-symbol decoration, Retro Print, Glitch, website hero, browser chrome, watermark. Fill edge to edge with the real app UI.
notes: Generated against the current Rambelle foundation and hexagonal pattern references.
